content.comment_body: Hello, Unfortunately, the deployment process is not working for me. At the moment, I have three policies listed in my console: - AWSIoTFullAccess - [BINARY_DATA_REMOVED] - [product_name]LWEPermission The last policy was created by copying from your guide file and renaming it as advised, but deployment to the cloud from [product_name] Web Editor is still unsuccessful. I would appreciate a thorough and updated guide specifically tailored for new users in 2023 to resolve this issue. Thank you for your help. Bye [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble deploying projects from [product_name] Web Editor to a cloud service, despite following the documented instructions and permissions adjustments. The provided guides and permissions setup don't resolve the deployment issue, resulting in confusion and preventing usage as intended. The feedback indicates lacking onboarding materials and comprehensive instructions for new users integrating with cloud platforms.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks clear, updated instructions for connecting and deploying [product_name] Web Editor projects to the cloud, along with straightforward permissions setup. They want a reliable process to achieve successful deployment without running into unknown issues and would value support resources tailored for the latest product and cloud service versions.
